rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Provides access to the Korea Pharmaceutical Information Center (KPIC) API for retrieving comprehensive drug and pharmaceutical information. Built with TypeScript and the MCP SDK, this server enables querying Korean pharmaceutical databases for drug details, interactions, safety information, and regulatory data. Useful for healthcare applications, medical research, drug safety analysis, and pharmaceutical compliance workflows where access to Korean drug information is required.
